question_text: Describe how you welcome a new employee on their first day.
expected_answer: You greet them warmly give a brief orientation and help them feel comfortable

question_text: Explain how you handle a simple employee question about company policy.
expected_answer: You provide the correct policy information and ensure they understand it

question_text: Describe how you assist an employee who needs help finding HR documents.
expected_answer: You guide them to the correct location and confirm they have the right files

question_text: Explain how you respond when an employee asks about available benefits.
expected_answer: You give a clear overview of the benefits and direct them to detailed resources

question_text: Describe how you help an employee update their personal information.
expected_answer: You show them the correct process and verify the update is completed

question_text: Explain how you handle an employee who is unsure about a required form.
expected_answer: You explain the purpose of the form and help them fill it out correctly

question_text: Describe how you support an employee who is nervous about a meeting.
expected_answer: You reassure them explain the meeting purpose and help them prepare

question_text: Explain how you provide basic guidance on attendance expectations.
expected_answer: You explain the schedule rules and confirm they understand the requirements

question_text: Describe how you help an employee understand their onboarding tasks.
expected_answer: You walk them through each step and make sure they know what to complete

question_text: Explain how you respond when an employee asks who to contact for payroll questions.
expected_answer: You direct them to the payroll team and provide the correct contact information
